title: MSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Modulate signal using CPM method, 1 input, 1 output, {Frequency pulse shape} sets Type of pulse shaping; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Input type} sets the integer or group of bits input indicator, {Symbol set ordering} sets the symbol mapping, {Modulation index}, {Main lobe pulse duration (symbol intervals)} sets the main lobe duration, {Rolloff}, {BT product} sets the product of bandwidth and symbol time of Gaussian pulse, {Pulse length (symbol intervals)} sets the length of frequency pulse shape, {Symbol prehistory} sets the data symbols used before the start, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the initial phase offset, {Samples per symbol} sets the symbol sampling rate, {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Enforce single-rate and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: Modulation order 4 (default) | power of two scalar

params.name: Input type
params.values: Integer or group of bits input indicator Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Modulation index
params.values: Modulation index { h i } 0.5 (default) | nonnegative scalar | column vector

params.name: Frequency pulse shape
params.values: Type of pulse shaping Rectangular (default) | Raised Cosine | Spectral Raised Cosine | Gaussian | Tamed FM

params.name: Rolloff
params.values: Rolloff factor of spectral raised cosine pulse shape 0.2 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: BT product
params.values: Product of bandwidth and symbol time of Gaussian pulse shape 0.3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse length (symbol intervals)
params.values: Length of frequency pulse shape 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Symbol prehistory
params.values: Data symbols used before the start of simulation 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing
